notes.title: Support for Ultrawide screens and more Quality of life Fixes!
notes.content:
I've added a few quality of life updates:

[list]
[*] Added support for Ultrawide screens
[*] Rebalanced a few provisions
[*] Upgrading buildings now takes time, and also takes provisions into account
[*] A few text updates to make things clearer
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Let me know your feedback! 😇
